thread:
maria-support: Heads up — we started seeing a huge uptick in 4xx/5xx for function calls to /v1/invoke around 10:05 UTC after parser service v2 went live. Customers reporting failures and increased latency. sample error from logs: 
```
error: function_call_schema_mismatch
code: 400
msg: unexpected field 'bodyArgs' in tool invocation
```
Any idea if v2 changed the expected schema?

anya-oncall: Confirming alert — SRE alert fired at 10:07. 4xx spike ~270/min (baseline ~8/min). Some 500s as well. Tagging @dev-ml and @kevin-ops.

sre-bot: [ALERT] function_call_errors > threshold (last 10m) — origin: parser-service-v2 — top_error: function_call_schema_mismatch — error_rate: 320/min

maria-support: Affects customers: acme-inc and beta-retail (enterprise). They've opened support cases complaining about malformed-args errors.

dev-ml: Looking into it. Quick check: parser-v2 changed how it serializes tool args — it now emits "parameters" instead of "args" when generating tool call payloads. Downstream router expects "args". That's a schema mismatch.

jon-custrep: Customer repro (from ACME): 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer XXX' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"tool":"place_order","args":{"sku":"A1","qty":2}}'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"function_call_schema_mismatch","message":"unexpected field 'args', expected 'parameters'"}

maria-support: So sometimes router expects args, other times parameters? That explains intermittent 200 -> 400 mix depending on which service version handled the request.

kevin-ops: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Rollback parser v2 (fast) 2) Add compatibility shim in router to accept both keys (safer but slower) 3) Patch parser v2 to emit args as well. Which should we do now?

dev-ml: Patch will take ~30-45m to build + test. Shim in router is ~15m but risky during high load. Rollback is safest for now.

kevin-ops: I'm initiating an emergency rollback. @deploy-bot start rollback parser-service to parser-v1-tag

deploy-bot: Deploy job started — rolling back parser-service to tag "parser-v1-2026-02-18" on prod (region: us-west2). Rolling update to 4 instances. ETA ~6m.

anya-oncall: Adding brief throttling rule to rate limit retry storms from our gateway while rollback completes.

maria-support: Logged customers and told them we're investigating; provided temporary status note.

sre-bot: [METRICS] 2m after rollback start — function_call_errors: 180/min (was 320/min peak).

deploy-bot: Rollback step 1/3 complete — 2/4 instances replaced. No failed pods.

dev-ml: Also sending a quick hotfix: parser-v2 will be updated to include both fields (args + parameters) to be backward compatible. I'll open PR now.

kevin-ops: Rollback complete. parser-service running at parser-v1. Confirm gateway schema compatibility restored.

sre-bot: [RESOLVED] error_rate returning to baseline. Current error_rate 9/min.

maria-support: Customers updated — ACME confirmed service is back for them (they saw 200s again).

anya-oncall: Filing incident and follow-up: action items: 1) postmortem (owner: dev-ml) 2) add compatibility tests for tool-call schema in staging 3) safer rollout gating for parser changes 4) include consumer contract tests in CI.

jon-custrep: Thanks team — I'll follow up with impacted customers and collect any residual logs.

kevin-ops: Great job. Marking as incident acknowledged; will move to postmortem channel after writeup. :thumbsup:
__notes: Generated slack thread about function-call schema mismatch after parser v2 rollout; includes mitigation and rollback. All values are strings or list of strings as required.
